pages.list.title: Pages
pages.list.deleted: Page deleted. Its URLs now answer 404.
pages.list.forbidden: You are not allowed to view pages
pages.field.title: Title
pages.field.slug_hint: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens. Leave empty to derive it from the title.
pages.edit.not_serving_title: Pages are not served at the site root yet
pages.edit.not_serving: Pick "Pages — /pages" under Settings → Application → 404 handler so that /<slug> shows this page and old URLs redirect with a 301.
pages.permalink.title: Permalink
pages.permalink.lead: The public address of this page. Once the page has been published, old addresses keep working and redirect permanently (301) to the new one.
pages.permalink.slug_hint: Lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens.
pages.permalink.redirected: The old address {from} now redirects permanently (301) to {to}.
pages.permalink.not_redirected: The page has never been published, so there is no old address to redirect.
pages.redirects.title: Old addresses that redirect
pages.redirects.lead: Each address below answers 301 straight to the current permalink.
pages.redirects.inactive: Redirects are off while the page is a draft: these addresses answer 404 until it is published again.
pages.redirects.empty: None yet. A redirect is created automatically when the slug of a page that has been published changes.
pages.err.slug_format: A slug may only contain lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens (e.g. about-us).
pages.err.slug_taken: This slug is already used by another page.
pages.err.slug_redirected: This slug is still an old address of another page (it redirects there).
pages.err.slug_race: This slug was just taken by another change. Try again.
pages.editor.hint: Write visually or in Markdown — both save Markdown. The preview shows the body exactly as it appears on the public page.
pages.editor.heading: Subheading
pages.editor.visual_failed: The visual editor could not be loaded; write Markdown below instead.
